The subject property is currently improved with 4 vacant buildings (former site of
All Saints St. Anthony Church campus: a church building, a rectory, a convent
building and a school building). The Applicant needs a zoning change to allow
adaptive reuse of the subject property in order to establish day care centers for
children and adults within the existing buildings.
